title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
statement: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
hints: dp[i] represents the length of the LIS ending at index i.
For each i, check all j < i where nums[j] < nums[i].
Or use binary search tails array for O(n log n).

solutions.title: Quadratic DP Tabulation
Binary Search Patience Piles
solutions.complexity: Time: O(n log n) | Space: O(n)
